text:
sam: kicking off llm-router v2.5.0 deploy in tonight's change window (23:00-01:00 UTC). Experiment: start in shadow mode then flip a tiny live slice. Flag flow: `llmroute_shadow`=true -> observe diffs -> `llmroute_live_percent` 1% -> ramp. release notes: https://redwood.internal/release/llm-router-v2.5.0 :rocket:

deploy-bot: Automated: deploy started service=llm-router version=v2.5.0 by sam. Canary -> shadow -> gradual. Manual approval required for live-percent ramps.

olivia: prefer shadow first. capture "semantic-drift" diff metric from evals pipeline. Gate: live enable only if diff < 1.5% AND p95 latency delta < 100ms.

sam: pinned route in manifest: `route.pin_model = \"v2.4-stable\"` for all traffic until manual unpin after +24h stable. Canary will shadow v2.5.0 only.

ops-bot: Reminder: runbook has two fast-disable commands. 1) full disable flag: ```/deploybot flag disable llmroute_live_percent``` 2) shadow-only revert: ```/deploybot flag set llmroute_shadow true; /deploybot flag set llmroute_live_percent 0``` Use whichever is least disruptive. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/llmroute-shadow-rollback

sre-oncall: monitoring infra. Preflight checks passed. Set automated rollback watches: if user-visible-regression > 2% OR p95 delta > 250ms for 2 consecutive minutes -> auto-disable live percent and re-pin to v2.4-stable.

neha: starting internal canary shadow now (QA override 100%). Will post diffs in 8m.

deploy-bot: Flag update: `llmroute_shadow` -> true, `llmroute_live_percent` -> 0 by sam (QA override applied).

neha: smoke (7m): semantic diffs 0.6%, throughput stable, p95 +15ms. No regression alerts.

olivia: looks good. Approving bump to 1% live at 23:12 UTC if no regressions in next 5m.

sam: /approve ramp to 1% live.

deploy-bot: Action executed: `llmroute_live_percent` -> 1% by sam at 23:12 UTC.

neha: post-ramp (5m): diff 0.9%, p95 = +22ms, errors negligible. Queue depth unchanged. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: infra note: small CPU uptick on router-fleet-a (avg +6%). No 5xx. Continuing watch. Auto rollback thresholds active.

olivia: schedule: hold 30m at 1% then consider 10% at next window. If diff creeps toward 1.5% we pause and open rollback.

sam: adding release note line: "Deploy v2.5.0 with shadow-first rollout. Live traffic initially 1% with automated rollback on regression or latency breaches. Model pinned to v2.4-stable until post-soak."

deploy-bot: Note: manual rollout actions require /approve from release owner. Fast-disable command available in runbook.

neha: will file a short post-deploy summary and unpin plan if soak completes. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
